source.citation: Ghia, U., Ghia, K.N., Shin, C.T. (1982). J. Comput. Phys. 48:387-411. Table I: u along vertical line through geometric center x=0.5, Re=100.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the 2D cavity mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Ghia 1982 used 129x129; a 80x80 (=6400) uniform mesh is the practical mid-resolution baseline. Hand-set, follow-up: replace with mesh-convergence noise floor.

final_residual_p.description: Final residual of the pressure equation at end of simulation
final_residual_p.T_good_source: Hand-set; SIMPLE on cavity routinely reaches 1e-5 or lower

u_centerline_y0p5.T_good_source: Ghia 1982 Table I central point; ~4% tolerance for well-resolved laminar cavity. Hand-set; calibrate via mesh study.

u_min_along_x0p5.description: most-negative u along vertical centreline x=0.5 (primary vortex peak)
u_min_along_x0p5.T_good_source: Ghia 1982 Table I row at y≈0.4531
